name: named object recovery
peak: maximum of the background-subtracted stack within search_radius_px of the predicted position
background: per-visit median subtracted from each visit before stacking
noise: local noise of the median variance at the peak, divided by the square root of the number of visits
threshold: the 95th percentile of the measured null for that visit series, with its binomial interval

verdicts.when: the predicted position falls outside the grid minus margin_px
verdicts.meaning: the prediction is not covered by the frames that exist

verdicts.when: no usable variance at the peak, or the peak is not finite
verdicts.meaning: the data there cannot support a statement either way

verdicts.when: snr is at least the threshold
verdicts.meaning: a source is present at the predicted position, above the measured threshold

verdicts.when: snr is at least 10 but below the threshold
verdicts.meaning: the peak is far above the local noise, and the threshold is raised by the target's own wings inside the stamp

verdicts.when: snr is below 10 and below the threshold
verdicts.meaning: the position is right and the object is fainter than this visit set can see

note: The threshold is not chosen here: it is the measured 95th percentile of the null for the same visit series, so the only fixed numbers are the search radius and the 10 sigma label. A change to this file changes its hash, and a recovery refuses to run when the hash does not match, so every result states the rule set it was produced under.
